title: Holy Spirit and Revelation
definition: The Holy Spirit and revelation refers to the Spirit's work in making God's truth known through the prophets, apostles, Scripture, and the witness to Christ.
summary: The Spirit reveals God's truth and bears witness to Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus promised that the Spirit would guide His people into truth and glorify Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Holy Spirit is the Spirit of revelation. He carried along the biblical authors, revealed God's truth, and bears witness to Christ through the Word.

Revelation does not mean believers can create new doctrine equal to Scripture. The Spirit who gave Scripture also points believers back to God's revealed truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people claim spiritual insight while neglecting Scripture. This doctrine matters because the Spirit's revealing work is never opposed to God's written Word.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek the Spirit's help to understand Scripture. Test every claimed revelation by the Word and by whether it honors Christ and the Gospel.
